description: scripts/check_self_explaining.py reports counts only on stderr, so neither the CI job summary nor the calibration report shows how many docstrings and comments a pull request added or removed, and the effect of the gate is not measured.
goal: Make scripts/check_self_explaining.py append a markdown summary to the file named by the GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY environment variable when it is set, on pass and on failure, with the number of changed files checked, added docstrings, added comments that are not '# why:' reasons, and the same counts for removed ones; do nothing extra when the variable is unset. Add the same counts, computed against the merge base with origin/main, to the calibration report generated by sandbox_executor/calibration/report.py as a short section. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: A gate whose catches are not counted cannot show whether it works; the counts go where the maintainer already reads the pull request outcome.
acceptance_criteria: Counts of added and removed docstrings and comments are emitted in the CI job summary: a test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_check_self_explaining.py runs scripts/check_self_explaining.py in a real temporary git repository with GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY pointing at a temporary file, once on a diff that adds a docstring and a plain comment (exit 1) and once on a clean diff (exit 0), and asserts the file holds the checked-file count, the added docstring count and the added comment count in both runs.
A test in the same file asserts that without GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY set no summary file is written and the exit codes are unchanged.

The counts are emitted in the calibration report: a test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_calibration_report_self_explaining_counts.py builds a report with apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/calibration/report.py for a real temporary git repository whose execution diff adds one docstring and removes one comment, and asserts the report section states added 1 docstring and removed 1 comment.
scripts/self_explaining_diff.py exposes the removed-line information needed for the removed counts and its existing behaviour for the check is unchanged.

**No count.** Nothing reports how many docstrings and comments a PR added or removed, so the trend and the effect of the gate are not measured. Emit the counts in the job summary and in the calibration report.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' passes.
